name: 'Link Checker'

# **What it does**: Renders the content of every page and check all internal links.
# **Why we have it**: To make sure all links connect correctly.
# **Who does it impact**: Docs content.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    # branches: [master, 'release/**']
    paths:
      - '**/*.md'
      - '**/link-check.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [2023.x, 2025.0.x, 2025.1.x, "release/**"]
    paths:
      - '**/*.md'
      - '**/link-check.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  # Needed for the 'trilom/file-changes-action' action
  pull-requests: read

# This allows a subsequently queued workflow run to interrupt previous runs
concurrency:
  group: '${{ github.workflow }} @ ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.label || github.head_ref || github.ref }}'
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Get script
        run: |
          wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xuruidong/markdown-link-checker/main/link_checker.py

      - name: Setup python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Link check (critical, all files)
        run: |
          # python link_checker.py ./ --enable-external --ignore "http://apisix.iresty.com" "https://www.upyun.com" "https://github.com/apache/apisix/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg" "https://httpbin.org/" "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cache"
          python link_checker.py ./

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
